game.name: Prototype (World)(En,Fr,Es,It)
game.desc: Prototype on Xbox 360 is a spectacular action game where the hero, Alex Mercer, has superhuman abilities. Faster than a car, more stuntman than the Yamakazis, the hero has the ability to take over the DNA of his opponents, including appearance, memories and abilities. The complex storyline goes back to the origins of Mercer's powers, linked to a mysterious infection in New York.
